question.prompt: The intersection of the lines $y=2x+1$ and $y=-x+m$ has an x-coordinate of 1. Find the value of $m$.

solutions.explanation: When $x=1$, the first line gives $y=2\times1+1=3$, so the intersection is $(1,3)$. Substituting into $y=-x+m$ gives $3=-1+m$, so $m=4$.
solutions.title: Find the common point and determine m
